decision: positive iff response >= threshold, including threshold 0 (all positive).

masks.korus_primary: white255 and gray128 positive; zero negative; other values ignored
masks.korus_secondary: white255 positive; zero negative; gray and intermediate ignored
masks.columbia: image-level primary; red/green provenance segmentation diagnostics separately, not pooled with binary forgery masks
masks.others: provided author mask >=128; native dimensions must match; missing/invalid mask recorded without invented labels

calibration: No fitting, model pruning or threshold optimization from the study. Best-observed threshold is exploratory and labeled as such.
full_execution: Original weights/architecture including learned global detector. Existing bounded global-attention implementation retains all keys; no spatial approximation.
timing_definition: Forward pass and map retrieval, excluding weight loading and disk I/O. TruFor precedes Mini for each image. The recorded batch used concurrent images; summed latencies are not independent elapsed batch times.
code_scope: Portable scientific reconstruction and paired inference; installation, orchestration and cleanup scripts are excluded.
